decisions.reason: Adding or removing questions does not change the established answer-layer requirements for questions that remain or are added.
The source concerns individual question additions and removals and does not change the permitted recommendations for category or chapter structure.
The instruction to curate the existing question set does not alter this new chapter's subject, format, or question-count policy.
The source does not modify the first-time-leader chapter's content focus, format, or question-count policy.
The source's general reference to adding and removing questions does not change the remote and hybrid leadership chapter.
The AI chapter is a basic non-question-and-answer chapter and is unaffected by curation of the question set.
The pre-interview preparation chapter remains unchanged because the source only directs question-set curation.
Question additions and removals do not alter the requirement to integrate international perspectives throughout the material.
Suggestion-mode proposals remain compatible with the existing editorial approval gate; the source does not waive or modify prior editorial review.
The source's workflow changes are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, while the question-curation decision adds no further workflow update or removal.
Curation of manuscript questions does not change the companion-learning asset deliverables or their delivery format.
Removing or adding questions may affect manuscript length in practice, but the source does not change the established 110,000-word ceiling or existing-edition estimate.
